title: Forward late Wine IME results in command console
changes: For the Wine command window, forward a nonempty IME result arriving after composition end through the existing Winit editor path once; preserve native Windows handling and discard no draft on cancellation.
validation: Windows GNU runtime/test builds and Wine editor, panel, command and composition-state tests passed. Private IBus Cangjie GUI verified 日 and repeated 日日, cancellation with selection preserved, F2 during composition, focus change, Italian è input and unchanged guest state.
limitations: Simulated Wine/Xvfb keyboard and one Cangjie engine; native Windows, physical inputs, other IMEs and capability guards remain under DBG2-14. Missing font glyphs need separate visual verification.
